title: Fiordilatte Savory Fritters with Pilaf
description: A delicate Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring crispy savory fritters topped with a flavorful pilaf. Serve as a satisfying snack or side dish.
instructions: In a bowl, mix 1 cup of shredded Fiordilatte with 2 tbsp of Savory.
Gradually add 1 cup of Aerated milk, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8-10 portions and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and coat with a small amount of Pilaf.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil and fry the fritters until golden brown.
Serve the fritters hot with a side of Pilaf and garnish with chopped Ukrainian dill.
